https://github.com/AndreeSalazar/BMO-X-x86-64

I'm Andree. I've been working on low-level systems and custom kernel space in Rust (no_std, Ring 0) and exploring minimal system footprint optimizations.

I recently joined the Zulip to follow the ongoing work around Rust abstractions, FFI safety, and kernel driver integration. Excited to learn from the discussions here and see where I can contribute or share insights!

Best regards,

Andree
